result.releaseSummary: Enhancements to the companion API with improved user authentication checks and new tests for role verification.
risks: {"affectedFile":"app/lib/auth/guards.ts","issue":"The requireUser function does not adequately handle cases where user roles are revoked after authentication, potentially allowing unauthorized access.","remediation":"Add checks to ensure that user roles are verified immediately before any sensitive actions are taken."}

{"affectedFile":"app/lib/auth/store.ts","issue":"The saveCompanionPreferences function does not prevent users with revoked roles from saving preferences, which could lead to unauthorized changes.","remediation":"Implement additional checks to ensure that the user's role is validated right before writing preferences."}

{"affectedFile":"app/api/agents/companion/route.ts","issue":"The API does not consistently enforce role checks before allowing access to agent data, which could expose sensitive information.","remediation":"Ensure that all API routes validate user roles and permissions before processing requests."}
smokeTests: Verify that all API endpoints return the correct status codes based on user roles.
Check that preferences can only be saved by users with valid roles.
regressionTests: Run existing tests to ensure that no previous functionality is broken due to new changes.
Test that revoked users cannot access or modify agent data.
edgeCases: Test behavior when a user's role is revoked immediately after authentication.
Check how the system behaves when multiple users with different roles attempt to access the same agent data.
adminChecks: Ensure that admin users can still access all functionalities without restrictions.
Verify that editor users can only access their assigned agents.
thirdPartyChecks: Confirm that the OpenAI API integration is functioning as expected and that error handling is robust.

rollbackSteps: Revert the changes made in the latest feature branch.
Restore the previous version of the affected files.

testResults: All previous tests passed, but new tests for role verification need to be added.

result.cursorFixPrompt: Implement additional checks in requireUser and saveCompanionPreferences to ensure that user roles are verified immediately before any sensitive actions are taken.
